description: This file contains code for merging and processing test report files, including functions for extracting, parsing, and merging JSONL report data, patching events, and handling report metadata. It defines classes and functions related to report merging, event patching, and report version modernization within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: UniqueFileNameGenerator
classes.description: Generates unique file names by appending an index if a name has been used before.

classes.name: IdsPatcher
classes.description: Patches test IDs in events to ensure uniqueness across merged reports, optionally adding a bot name tag.

classes.name: AttachmentPathPatcher
classes.description: Adjusts attachment paths in events to point to a resource directory.

classes.name: PathSeparatorPatcher
classes.description: Replaces path separators in event data to match the current platform's separator.

classes.name: GlobalErrorPatcher
classes.description: Prefixes error messages and stacks with a bot name prefix.

classes.name: WorkerIndexPatcher
classes.description: Adjusts worker indices in test begin events to account for merged report context.

classes.name: JsonEventPatchers
classes.description: Manages a collection of event patchers and applies them to events.

classes.name: BlobModernizer
classes.description: Handles modernization of report events from older versions to the current format.

methods.name: createMergedReport
methods.description: Main function to create a merged test report from multiple shard files, handling extraction, parsing, patching, and final report assembly.

methods.name: parseCommonEvents
methods.description: Parses and filters common metadata events from report JSON lines.

methods.name: parseTestEvents
methods.description: Parses and filters test-related events from report JSON lines.

methods.name: splitBufferLines
methods.description: Splits a buffer into lines based on newline characters.

methods.name: extractAndParseReports
methods.description: Extracts report files from zip archives, parses events, and gathers metadata.

methods.name: findMetadata
methods.description: Extracts report metadata from the first event, verifying version compatibility.

methods.name: mergeEvents
methods.description: Merges multiple report event streams into a combined event stream with proper configuration and end events.

methods.name: mergeConfigureEvents
methods.description: Combines multiple configuration events into a single configuration event.

methods.name: mergeConfigs
methods.description: Merges two configuration objects into one.

methods.name: mergeEndEvents
methods.description: Creates a final onEnd event summarizing the merged report results.

methods.name: sortedShardFiles
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of report shard files (.zip) in a directory.

methods.name: printStatusToStdout
methods.description: Outputs status messages to standard output.
